Third-party code vendored in resources/kit/vendor. Update by replacing the files with the
same pinned npm releases (or newer ones) and regenerating this file.

KaTeX's fonts are the KaTeX project's Computer Modern-derived faces, used under the SIL Open
Font License 1.1; everything else in KaTeX is MIT. Its license follows.

pele.global.js has no runtime dependencies: its YAML, URL and entity handling are its own and
its parsers are hand-written against Mermaid 12.1.0's grammars. Pele is MIT, like Mermaid.
